argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'
$paths=@('E:\video1','E:\video2','E:\video3','E:\WebAIBridge','E:\boss','E:\SpectraTrack','E:\PC-Control','E:\pc-github-relay')
$out=@()
foreach($p in $paths){
  $exists=Test-Path -LiteralPath $p
  $git=$false;$remote='';$branch='';$head=''
  if($exists -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p '.git'))){
    $git=$true
    $remote=(git -C $p remote get-url origin 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1)
    $branch=(git -C $p branch --show-current 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1)
    $head=(git -C $p rev-parse HEAD 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1)
  }
  $out += [pscustomobject]@{path=$p;exists=$exists;git=$git;remote=$remote;branch=$branch;head=$head}
}
$ffmpeg=(where.exe ffmpeg 2>$null | Select-Object -First 3)
$ffprobe=(where.exe ffprobe 2>$null | Select-Object -First 3)
[pscustomobject]@{paths=$out;ffmpeg=@($ffmpeg);ffprobe=@($ffprobe)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress

note: Targeted read-only local repo/path and ffmpeg check; no protected-path access
